about: Prices per million tokens, in USD, region global. Each tariff names its source and the day it was read; a price changes by a new entry with its date of effect, never by rewriting one. Outside the global region, Vertex costs about 10 % more. When two sources disagree, the higher price is kept: the cap errs on the safe side.
